name: Web Search Pattern
description: AI with web search capability for real-time information
explanation:
Pattern for AI with web search capability.

Key settings:
- AI node: selectedTools.webSearch = true
- Web Search tool node connected to AI (dashed line)
- webSearchDomains: Optional comma-separated domains to restrict search

Connection:
- Connect AI node's 'tools' handle to Web Search node
- Edge style: dashed (strokeDasharray: "5, 5")

Use cases:
- Real-time news/information lookup
- Current events research
- Price checking
- Stock quotes
- Weather information
